We need to fix compilation errors. Issues:

- Imports for JUnit Jupiter and Mockito not available. Likely this test should use JUnit 4 only. We can replace annotations with JUnit 4 equivalents: @Before (instead of @BeforeEach), @Test from org.junit.Test already imported. Remove JUnit Jupiter imports and MockitoExtension annotation.

- Remove @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) line.

- Remove @ParameterizedTest and @CsvSource; instead we can implement a regular test method that loops over data. Already they attempted to use parameterized but we can just keep method without parameters. Change method signature to void whenProfitIsSpecialNumericValue_thenHasLossBehavesAccordingly() and remove annotation.

- The method call in main currently passes no args; after change, it's fine.

- The anonymous Num implementations need to implement all abstract methods of Num interface. The errors about function() method: In newer versions, Num extends java.util.function.Function<Number, Num>. So need to implement apply(Number) method instead of function(). Actually the interface may have method apply(Number) returning Num. Let's check typical ta4j Num interface: In ta4j-core, Num extends Comparable<Num>, Function<Number, Num>. It defines default methods maybe. Implementing anonymous class must implement apply(Number). Provide implementation returning this.

Thus replace function() method with apply(Number number) returning this.

Also many @Override annotations on methods not present in interface; we should remove them. In anonymous class, we can just implement required methods (plus, minus, etc.) and apply. The code currently has many @Override; they are okay if methods exist. The errors were because function() method signature mismatched. So change method name to apply(Number) and remove @Override on it.

Also there were errors about many @Override in the anonymous class for deceptiveNum; same fix.

Also the test class had duplicate setUp method and also @BeforeEach method; we can keep only JUnit4 @Before method. Use @Before annotation.

Remove import of org.junit.jupiter.api.* and other JUnit5 imports.

Also remove import of org.junit.jupiter.params.* and MockitoExtension.

Now adjust code accordingly.

Also the main method uses test.whenProfitIsSpecialNumericValue_thenHasLossBehavesAccordingly(); after change method name same.

Now ensure Position class exists with hasLoss method; fine.

Also need to import org.junit.Before for @Before.

Let's craft corrected code.
